description: This file contains a basic implementation of an Android RecognitionService named VoiceRecognitionService, which simulates voice recognition results based on user preferences. It does not perform real voice recognition but returns preset results for letters or numbers.

classes.name: VoiceRecognitionService
classes.description: An Android RecognitionService subclass that simulates speech recognition results based on user preferences.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of recognition, currently empty as this is a sample implementation.

methods.name: onStartListening
methods.description: Simulates recognition results by returning predefined letter or number lists based on preferences.

methods.name: onStopListening
methods.description: Handles stopping of recognition, currently a no-op in this sample.
